review.url_auth: All 72 files contain only the same two fixed negative-test user:password / name:password URL patterns.
review.access_token: 16 files contain amino-acid sequences. One Kubernetes latest.json has two LTAI substrings inside embedded base64 source archives.
review.signed_url: All six are the source expression token=self.token_file.read_text().strip(), including historical copies.
review.env_secret: MCP_PROVIDER_TOKEN is the placeholder __T01_MCP_PROVIDER_ID__; SECRET is the Kubernetes resource name antigen-design-credentials.
review.yaml_ini_env_scan: No literal credential matches in selected YAML/YML/ENV/TOML/INI/CFG files.
review.frozen_binding: provider-bindings.local_dify_1_17.json contains only frozen mock registry/provider IDs and hashes, no credentials; preserved for freeze verification.

limitations: Pattern inspection is not a proof that arbitrary file content cannot contain a secret.
Virtual environments, local credentials, personal binding configuration and scratch directories are excluded.
